assignments.name: enrich_prompt
assignments.value:
Research this small US business and collect public information about it.

Business:
{business}

Already found on their own website (trust this and do not open their website again):
{website_findings}

Search for what is still missing, in these places:
{sources}

Rules:
- Search by phone number as well as name + city. Only use pages that clearly match this business.
- Only report facts you actually found. Never guess or make up an email address.
- Use null (or []) for anything you could not find. Do not log in anywhere.

Reply with only this JSON inside <json></json> tags:
<json>{
 "confirmed": true or false,
 "phone": "", "email": "", "instagram_url": "", "facebook_url": "",
 "other_profiles": ["listing urls: Google, Yelp, BBB, Angi..."],
 "rating": number or null, "review_count": number or null,
 "top_reviews": ["short quote, max 3"],
 "services": ["what they offer"], "about": "2-3 sentences",
 "photo_urls": ["direct image urls, max 4"],
 "headline": "short website headline", "tagline": "one line"
}</json>
